script:
--[[ 
    RequireX executor.
    MATCHES YOUR DESIGN 1:1
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- MAIN GUI SETUP
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "RequireX_Executor"
gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui

-- MAIN GREY FRAME
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 300)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225, 0.5, -150)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 110, 110) -- DARK GREY
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
mainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Parent = gui

-- LOGO / TITLE (RequireX executor.)
local logo = Instance.new("TextLabel", mainFrame)
logo.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 60)
logo.Position = UDim2.new(0.67, 0, 0.05, 0)
logo.Text = "RequireX\nexecutor."
logo.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
logo.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne -- BLOCKY FONT
logo.TextSize = 22
logo.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- EXECUTOR BOX (WHITE)
local input = Instance.new("TextBox", mainFrame)
input.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 200)
input.Position = UDim2.new(0.03, 0, 0.08, 0)
input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
input.Text = "require here..."
input.PlaceholderText = "require here..."
input.ClearTextOnFocus = true
input.MultiLine = true
input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
input.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
input.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
input.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
input.TextSize = 18

-- BUTTONS (BOTTOM)
local execute = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
execute.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
execute.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 0.8, 0)
execute.Text = "execute"
execute.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
execute.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
execute.TextSize = 25
execute.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
execute.BorderSizePixel = 0

local clear = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
clear.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
clear.Position = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0.8, 0)
clear.Text = "clear require"
clear.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
clear.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
clear.TextSize = 22
clear.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
clear.BorderSizePixel = 0

-- LOGIC
execute.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        loadstring(input.Text)()
    end)
end)

clear.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    input.Text = ""
end)

-- CLOSE BUTTON
local close = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
close.Text = "X"
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0, 0)
close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)

print("RequireX executor loaded!")
